notes: New shelf, no old data. Organ archetypes are maker-free patterns from the Tendance Parfums guide and Anya's Garden (2017). Left out: Septimus Piesse's 'octophone' scent-keyboard (Wikipedia Perfume_organ page; a 19th-century concept, no evidence of surviving or ownable examples); Perfumer's Apprentice and PellWall kits (only Basenotes threads found, which returned 403 — not attested); smelling-strip makers (none named on retrieved pages); brand entries for Pairfum, The Fragrance Foundry and MGA (no about pages retrieved). Lab-kit and strip models are single-retailer examples, not market-covering.
